caption: The drawing features a single metallic object positioned centrally on a light beige background. The object is shaped like a pair of tongs or pincers with two elongated legs extending downward and slightly outward from a rounded, cylindrical top. The object is rendered in shades of brown and rust, indicating a weathered or aged metallic texture. The area immediately surrounding the object is a washed, uneven rectangle of pale yellowish color, subtly separating the object from the rest of the white background. There is a small, handwritten signature in brown ink on the lower right side beneath the object. The composition is minimalistic, with the object isolated and placed vertically in the center of the drawing.
title: Bishop Hill: Dowel Cutter
